voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: The torn orc banner is convincing at a distance. Up close, every knot looks tied for someone to find.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: The first arrow strikes the medicine wagon, and the quiet road becomes a battlefield before anyone can name the enemy.

voiceCues.speaker: Mara
voiceCues.text: I will take the road with you, but civilians do not become expendable when the evidence gets difficult.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: Greywatch closes its gates as raiders test the north wall. Inside, frightened families wait for orders that may already be compromised.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: The wounded witness names a human paymaster and a false banner. His testimony turns a border raid into a deliberate conspiracy.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: The attackers raise opposing banners on the same road. The lie survives only if both armies answer before they look closely.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: A captured courier carries two sets of orders: one meant for human patrols, and one written to provoke the Free Host.

voiceCues.speaker: Rukhar
voiceCues.text: I join as an equal voice for the Free Host, not as a trophy taken from a peace table.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: Human and orc commanders meet between their lines while hidden hands prepare the violence that will make negotiation impossible.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: Redwater can become a truce, a withdrawal, or the first open battle of a war someone else designed.

voiceCues.speaker: Caldus
voiceCues.text: The abbey knows my name. My duty belongs to the people its locked doors failed.

voiceCues.speaker: Lyra
voiceCues.text: Careful proof travels slowly, but it survives the moment when a powerful man calls every witness a liar.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: One hidden forge stamps weapons for both armies. The same steel has been sharpened into two different accusations.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: The seals, payments, and witness accounts agree on one name: Marshal Severin Voss.

voiceCues.speaker: Caldus
voiceCues.text: The wounded need a healer, and the evidence needs a witness. We cannot pretend either duty is painless.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: Smoke rises over Greywatch before the evidence can reach its council. The conspiracy has returned to destroy its own record.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: When the siege bell falls silent, survivors count more than walls. They count witnesses, families, and the truth still in their hands.

voiceCues.speaker: Rukhar
voiceCues.text: Protect the witnesses first. A victory that loses the truth only prepares the next war.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: The march on Crownless Keep begins with a council, because a coalition that cannot agree on limits will become another occupying army.

voiceCues.speaker: Eldrin
voiceCues.text: Beyond the inner gate, the keep is not a throne room. It is a machine of orders, cells, archives, and controlled fear.

voiceCues.speaker: Lyra
voiceCues.text: Count every seal before we close the hall. No one will inherit authority from a vote that never lawfully ended.

voiceCues.speaker: Talla
voiceCues.text: I will share the hidden road, but no council owns it. The people who need escape come first.

voiceCues.speaker: Voss
voiceCues.text: Break my command today, and tomorrow every frightened captain will raise a banner of his own.

voiceCues.speaker: Voss
voiceCues.text: I did not create their hatred. I built the only command strong enough to keep that hatred from consuming the border.
